Sleep, food and recovery stay steady
A stalled week is repeated, not forced

cases.title: First half marathon, one day a week (mine)

input.baseline: I run 3 km once a week at an easy pace.

asked.question: Do you have a finish time in mind?

coachNote.message: One run a week is too little to build safely from 3 km; a first half marathon calls for 2–3 runs a week on the steady plan or 3–4 on the focused plan.

baselineMeasurements.sourceQuote: I run 3 km once a week at an easy pace.
I run 3 km once a week at an easy pace.

options.rationale: A patient build from 3 km a week toward a first half marathon finish, with gradual weekly increases and easy running. Success means finishing, with no time target.
assumptions: No injuries or health limits that stop gradual running
2 to 3 running days per week are kept up
Easy pace is conversational, no pace data given
Weeks may repeat if a week feels too hard
